user.title: HomeKit Smart Sync
user.description:
Select the HomeKit bridge(s) Smart Sync should manage.

Note: when entities or areas change, the bridge is reloaded after an ~8s debounce. Apple Home may briefly show accessories as "Not Responding" while the bridge reconnects.

abort.no_homekit_bridges: No HomeKit bridge is configured. Set up the HomeKit integration first.
abort.already_configured: HomeKit Smart Sync is already configured.

error.no_bridge_selected: Select at least one bridge to manage.

init.title: HomeKit Smart Sync
init.description: Pick the bridges to manage and, for each feature, the subset of those bridges where it should run. Changes trigger a debounced reload of the affected bridges.

data.filter_bridges: Bridges with Smart Filter for voice

set_alias.name: Set HomeKit alias
set_alias.description: Override the auto-cleaned alias for a specific entity. The given name is pushed to the HomeKit bridge on the next sync and used by Apple Home and Siri instead of the entity's friendly name.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Entity whose HomeKit alias should be overridden.

alias.name: Alias
alias.description: Name to show in Apple Home (1–64 characters).

clear_alias.name: Clear HomeKit alias
clear_alias.description: Drop a previously set manual alias and let the auto-cleaner resume for this entity.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Entity whose manual alias should be removed.

set_translation.name: Set term translation
set_translation.description: Register a term substitution applied to every auto-cleaned alias. Multi-word phrases are matched longest-first.

translation.name: Replacement
translation.description: Word or phrase to substitute in (1–64 characters).

clear_translation.name: Clear term translation
clear_translation.description: Remove a previously registered term substitution.

term.name: Source term
term.description: Phrase whose substitution should be removed.

pick_host.title: Pick the host entity
pick_host.description: Apple Home will attach the sensor {sensor} (via {config_key}) to the entity you choose below.
